[P2] Retain the interruption when forced shutdown throws

If the caller is interrupted while awaiting executor termination and `shutdownNow()` then throws, this catch exits before creating the lifecycle failure containing `interrupted`. The caller receives the shutdown error without the original interruption in its diagnostic graph. Capture the interruption failure before calling `shutdownNow()`, then aggregate any fallback failure while preserving fatal precedence. Extend the `INTERRUPTED_FALLBACK` regression to assert that both failures remain reachable.
